Text: “Permanent weapon is •Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; if targeting a Jedi, draw two destiny, otherwise draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny +1 > defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Aurra Sing With Blaster Rifle (Errata)]], 20 February 2023): Players Committee card image, 20 February 2023: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-aurrasingwithblasterrifle.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8c98fe0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/aurrasingwithblasterrifle.png Holotable commit 8c98fe0 “Set 12 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “Permanent weapon is •Aurra Sing's Blaster Rifle (may target a character for free; if targeting a Jedi, draw two destiny, otherwise draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny +1 > defense value).” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details and the copyright line “© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the card now prints the errata mark “E1”; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
